t.name: Dikkop Trail
t.description: The Dikkop Trail is a circular walk (9.5 -22.3km) (meanders up north) which includes pristine strandveld, dune veld and a 2km walk along the beach. The walk is most spectacular in spring when the wild flowers along the route are in bloom.
